tutorials.title: Multiworld Setup Guide
tutorials.description: A guide to setting up Perfect Dark for MultiWorld.
tutorials.text:
# Perfect Dark Archipelago Setup Guide

## Required Software

- [Archipelago 0.6.7](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest)
- [Latest Perfect Dark apworld](https://github.com/ajeloom/Archipelago/releases)
- [Latest Perfect Dark AP Client](https://github.com/ajeloom/Archipelago/releases)
- A Perfect Dark (NTSC 1.1) rom file. The Archipelago community cannot provide these.

## Recommended Software

- [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases?q=Tracker) - tells you what missions, challenges, and other locations you can complete

## Setup

1. Install the perfect_dark.apworld with the Archipelago Launcher (Install APWorld) or you could put it in the 'custom_worlds' folder in your Archipelago directory
2. Create a yaml file using the Archipelago Launcher (Generate Template Options) which can be found in the 'Players/Templates' folder. 
3. Configure the yaml settings, then place it in the 'Players' folder in your Archipelago directory
4. Generate your game in the Archipelago Launcher (Generate)
5. Host the game through their [site](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) or locally
6. Inside the Perfect Dark AP Client folder, place your rom in the data folder and rename it to 'pd.ntsc-final.z64'
7. Open pd.x86_64 and use the '/connect ip:port slotname password' command in the console to connect to the server
8. You are ready to play.

More info: 
- [Archipelago Setup Guide](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup_en)
- [Perfect Dark PC Port](https://github.com/fgsfdsfgs/perfect_dark)

## Updating

If you have an old version of the client, you can update to the newest version without having to delete any files.

1. Download the latest version of the client and apworld
2. Drag all the files inside the Perfect Dark AP Client folder you just downloaded and replace the files in the old one
3. Follow the steps from the setup section to get started

## Switching Rooms

You can switch rooms without restarting the client. Simply type "/disconnect" in the Perfect Dark Client's console, then connect to a different slot/room.

readme.text:
# Perfect Dark (PC) Archipelago

## What is this?
This is a separate build of the Perfect Dark PC port that integrates [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg/). The main feature of this is to allow the game to be played in a multiworld. In a multiworld, you work together with other players to complete each of your games. You do this by completing checks in your game to send an item which could be yours or another player's item.

For Perfect Dark, your weapons, gadgets, missions, and challenges are items that are locked until you find them. Weapons and gadgets that you normally start with in missions will not appear in your inventory and cannot be picked up until they are sent. To send checks, you will have to complete mission objectives, missions, challenges, etc. You can also change your gameplay settings to change your game's experience with the multiworld.

To get started, follow our [setup guide](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/blob/main/worlds/perfect_dark/docs/setup_en.md).

You can [find our releases here](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/releases).

If you find any issues or want to suggest anything to add, please report them on our [issues page](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/issues).

You can view the code for the client and how to build it [here](https://github.com/ajeloom/perfect_dark/tree/port-aprandomizer).

For a closer look at the current features, check out the [game info page](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/blob/main/worlds/perfect_dark/docs/game_info.md).

## Current Features
- Four goals:
  - Complete Skedar Ruins
  - Collect Mission Stars
  - Collect Challenge Stars
  - Collect Both
- Completing the following sends a check:
  - Mission Objectives
  - Mission Completion
  - Challenges
  - Firing Range
  - Device Training
  - Holotraining
  - Cheat Unlocks
- Weapon Progression
- Traps
- Death Link
- Random player characters
- Random enemy weapons
- Random music

## Known issues
- Closing the game will sometimes crash the client

## Planned Features
- Linux and Mac Support

## Credits

- Ryan Dwyer for decompiling the game
- black-silver for creating [apclientpp](https://github.com/black-sliver/apclientpp)
- axxiim for helping with the logic and playtest
- Maegis and Lebon14 for providing the original ideas for the AP
- Special thanks to the following for feedback and suggestions:
  - Sal the Dragon
  - Ryason55
  - lx5
  - Hinaloth
  - Freaky Mutant Man
- Everyone on the AP discord server who tried this out

notes.text:
This update fixes a lot of issues and adds other requested features. There is currently only a build for Windows. It can be played on Linux with Wine.

If you are updating, download and drag all the files inside the new build folder to your old pd-ap folder and replace the files. For more info on setting up, check out the [setup guide](https://github.com/ajeloom/Perfect-Dark-PC-AP/blob/main/worlds/perfect_dark/docs/setup_en.md).

The new client is only compatible with v0.7.0 apworld. Any multiworlds started before this update will not work with the new client.

## New Features
- Random enemy heads and bodies
  - Randomizes based on the seed.
- N-Bomb Trap
  - Spawns an N-Bomb on the player.
- Added a disable blur setting for people who may experience motion sickness.
## Changes
- Each file can now save separate server address and slot name.
- The server address and slot name are now displayed under the file.
- Change agent will disconnect you from the room.
- You can now see the time to beat and exit to take in the mission pause menu.
- Shortened the names of checks that were long.
- It now displays the exit checks you have remaining rather than all the exits you have to do.
- Slow Motion trap will no longer slow down the timer and extended to 30 seconds like other traps.
- Shorten the Perfect Darkness trap to 15 seconds.
- Enemies can now randomly throw N-Bomb if Random Enemy Weapons is enabled.
- Replaced the Start With All Challenges option in the YAML with Challenges in the Item Pool.
- Adjusted the logic of many checks.
- Adjusted how much ammo is given.
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where it sends a check when picking up the wrong weapon.
- Fixed a bug where you can send the timed cheat check without beating the time.
- Fixed a bug where the time to beat was hidden when the timed cheat location was not checked.
- Fixed a bug where doors in A51 Escape (Agent) would stay locked.
- Fixed a bug where it only used the model of Devastator for the weapons you can originally sacrifice in Skedar Ruins.
- Fixed a bug where it displays death link text when you did not receive it.
- Fixed a bug where it crashes when closing the game with the console opened.
- Fixed a bug where it randomized certain weapons needed for Pickupsanity.
